    Elite Expertise for Every Property, From Historic Estates to Modern Condos.

    Salem Steamer serves the McLean and Washington, DC metropolitan area and is built on a simple principle: every property and every client deserves the highest standard of care. Whether you own a historic home, single-family residence, condominium, or commercial property, we treat your space with the utmost regard.

    We understand the trauma you are going through and will treat you and your family with the respect and concern you deserve. To make this difficult time easier, we provide two key advocates at no cost to you: a Public Adjuster to handle your insurance claim and a Third-Party Certified Lab to certify your environment is truly safe.

    When you choose Salem Steamer, the only thing we leave behind is your peace of mind.

    Salem Steamer operates under internationally recognized IICRC standards for restorative cleaning and environmental services. We maintain full licensing and insurance compliance and adhere to defined operational systems developed since 2003. Our reputation is not marketing-driven—it is performance-driven, validated by over 300 verified client reviews and decades of field execution.

    What Sets Us Apart

    White-Glove Service for Every Client

    Our teams are vetted, uniformed, and professional. We communicate clearly, protect your privacy, and ensure a seamless experience—no matter the size of your project.

    Technical Expertise for Any Finish

    We employ advanced, industry-leading techniques for soot, odor, and mold remediation that are safe for any surface—from antique hardwood to modern building materials.

    A Public Adjuster, Paid by Us

    For clients navigating insurance claims, we provide a public adjuster—at our cost—who will negotiate on your behalf for the fullest and fairest settlement possible.

    Third-Party Certified Lab Report

    We engage an independent, third-party certified laboratory to scientifically analyze post-remediation samples and validate that your indoor air quality meets stringent health standards.

    As Discreet as You Want Us to Be

    Unmarked vehicles, sealed records, paperless transactions, NDAs, and code names for high-profile clients. Your legacy stays secure.

    The Salem Steamer Method.

    Defined Systems. Measurable Standards. Consistent Results.

    Assessment Protocol

    Every project begins with a structured evaluation process to identify material type, contamination level, moisture conditions, and risk factors.

    Controlled Restoration Process

    We apply IICRC-aligned procedures using calibrated equipment and controlled application methods to protect fibers, surfaces, and structural materials.

    Documentation & Verification

    Moisture readings, inspection points, and post-service validation ensure measurable performance—not guesswork.

    Client Assurance Standard

    Clear communication, defined scope, and satisfaction confirmation complete every service cycle.

    Built on standardized operating procedures designed for consistent execution across every service location.
